Questions

Which WageGrid metro has the highest Bartenders annual median?

Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA has the highest published OEWS May 2025 annual median for Bartenders ($58,180). Among metros with a published median: Seattle $58,180, Chicago $31,200, Austin $23,670. WageGrid does not rank suppressed cells or invent a missing wage.

Which WageGrid metro employs the most Bartenders?

Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN has the highest published OEWS May 2025 employment for Bartenders (28,750 wage-and-salary workers). Published employment: Chicago 28,750, Seattle 9,640, Austin 7,130. Self-employed workers are excluded.

Where are Bartenders most concentrated relative to the national mix?

Chicago has the highest published location quotient (1.31). Published LQs: Chicago 1.31, Austin 1.13, Seattle 0.95.

What is the hourly median for Bartenders in each metro?

OEWS May 2025 hourly medians: Austin $11.38; Chicago $15.00; Seattle $27.97. Blank means BLS withheld the estimate.

Does this comparison include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment estimate.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
